## My Story

I grew up in Glendora, California, and was a four-year varsity letter winner at South Hills high school, where I also graduated as valedictorian. I went on to play college baseball at Division II Azusa Pacific University. My best year came in 2023 where I hit .400 and we won a PacWest conference championship. I would eventually be named team captain in my senior season. I graduated in the spring of 2025 with a B.S. in Accounting and a minor in Business Analytics.

After graduating, I stayed at APU as a graduate assistant coach for the 2026 season. I served as the team's hitting coach, scouted opposing offenses, and called pitches during games. Our offense's runs scored per game and our pitching staff's K/BB rate both improved over 10% in that span. During the same year, I earned my Master's in Business Analytics from Cal Poly Pomona.

In the summer of 2026, I joined the coaching staff at Cal State Northridge as Director of Analytics.

## What I Do at CSUN

In my current role, I oversee four student managers, and together we run the program's analytics. We produce every tool and report the coaching staff uses to evaluate players, guide player development, and assess recruits.

- **Positional reports:** This fall we created pitcher, hitter, and catcher reports and set up workflows to automate the process so that they can be produced at regular intervals throughout the season.
- **Advance scouting:** I lead our scouting of opposing teams, building the reports and delivering insights the staff uses for pitch calling, defensive positioning and lineup construction.
- **Stuff+:** My own project, a Big West Stuff+ model to grade pitch quality for our pitchers and potential recruits.

## Beyond the Dugout

Over the past five years I have been running my own hitting lessons business, **.406 Baseball Academy**, working with hundreds of kids ages 6-18 throughout the San Gabriel Valley. I manage all the scheduling, advertising, finances, communication with parents, and deliver all the lessons myself.

Away from baseball, I'm usually at a concert or playing guitar. And I'm a lifelong San Francisco Giants fan.
